configuration.first_rotation: full period from writer open (benchmark only)

metrics.rate_note: startup/shutdown rates normalized per hour; not steady-state rotation

measurement_scope.timed: reconcile/startup + WS/REST capture + availability monitor + drain/seal/stop
measurement_scope.excluded: imports, fixture generation, Catalog schema creation, offline Raw audit
measurement_scope.queue_wait: Spool enqueue to dequeue, monotonic clock, one sample per frame
measurement_scope.persist_lag: receive to append completion, monotonic clock, one sample per frame
measurement_scope.fsync: Raw writer fsync only; directory/compression fsync included in seal time
measurement_scope.seal: successful _seal_current calls only, including startup empty boundaries
measurement_scope.rss: current RSS sampled every 10ms and at boundaries; lifetime peak separate
measurement_scope.sqlite: DML statement time vs BEGIN-to-COMMIT/autocommit transaction time
measurement_scope.limitations: synthetic burst; 1m/5m intervals; no steady-state backlog claim; background verification worker is not started
